verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs cover a built-in query feature (`{{query ...}}`, `/query`), and community users note advanced queries exist, though they are hard for beginners and poorly documented. The pack shows no evidence of querying specifically by properties, or of rendering results as live table, board or list views. missing for 10: documented property-based query filters, table/board/list database-style views of query results, in-depth advanced query documentation, hands-on corroboration of property queries.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can query my notes by their structured properties and render live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) from those queries

citations.quote: Simple queries by using `{{query }}`, the format is something like this: {{query Something you're looking for}}
Queries are for asking questions from your knowledge base
Tagging blocks makes them typed things (project, author, quote).
